# telnyx_email_domain_verify (Action)

Checks the DNS records of an email domain now, instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check the DNS records again after publishing them. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later.
action "telnyx_email_domain_verify" "mail" {
  config {
    domain_id = telnyx_email_domain.mail.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The domain id.
